ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65% low-intensity black to 35% high-intensity white across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity black area centered at the peduncle and extending through the mid-lobes; high-intensity white mottling is concentrated in large contiguous patches on the distal halves of both the left and right lobes, reaching the lateral tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: A narrow, deep V-shaped depression with a pixel angle of approximately 40 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Low-frequency, low-amplitude irregularities along the trailing edge; specific small-scale jaggedness (peaks <5 pixels) is visible on the inner trailing edge of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Generally convex trailing edge profile curving outward and upward toward the tips, with a slight concave recurve near the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct yellowish-white, high-contrast irregular clusters located at the extreme terminal tips of both lobes, indicative of localized parasitic or barnacle attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several visible thin, unaligned high-contrast linear streaks (rake marks) crossing the black-pigmented regions of the inner lobes, primarily oriented on a diagonal axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent, irregular growths/scarring at the distal tips of both lobes, with a more pronounced yellowish mass on the viewer's right lobe tip.
other_distinctive_markers: The specific density of white mottling on the anterior margins of the fluke tips forms a distinct speckled transition into the solid black central area.
